name: Instant-NGP
aliases: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
definition: A method introducing multiresolution hash coding to accelerate training throughput by three orders of magnitude compared to vanilla NeRF, offloading representational burden from MLP to hash-table lookups.
summary: Instant-NGP is a real-time NeRF training and rendering method that achieves 1000x speedups over vanilla NeRF by replacing positional encoding with multi-resolution hash encoding and occupancy grids.
